release: FY 2025 NMTC public data release, FY 2003–2023

method.unit: Unique project; financing flows grouped by transaction origination year.
method.amounts: Integer US cents. Nominal reported QLICI financing, not inflation-adjusted, tax expenditure, additional investment or causal effects.
method.geography: 2020 Census tract internal points, not project coordinates. All flows assigned to the project sheet representative tract, state and metro classification. Multi-tract projects may finance activity elsewhere.
method.missing: Five projects in AS, GU and VI have no match in the national Gazetteer. Retained in all relevant totals and tables; no invented map positions.
method.time: Filter transaction origination years; a project may appear in several years, counted once within a selected interval. Project-level characteristics are held fixed. Years 2001 and 2002 occur in the published workbook despite the release title.
method.metro: Project-sheet classification using 2020 tracts and March 2020 OMB definitions, not current rural eligibility.
method.cost: Estimated total project cost is retained for source inspection, not interpreted as private capital or multiplied by financing.
method.research: Separate descriptive atlas. The NMTC paper retains its 2001–2022 dataset and original estimates.
